brief_rationale: No responsibility-chain errors. All five RCs met with appropriate citations. Doctor obtained records via workspace, avoided definitive medication decisions without proper authorization, screened red flags repeatedly, established follow-up plan including left kidney nodule surveillance, and adapted to patient's transport/cost barriers. Four high-order points completed with meaningful trajectory impact: real-world constraint navigation (multiple low-burden pathways), responsibility chain repair (clarified ethambutol/海群生 as old medication, coordinated with surgery team), patient-state-sensitive communication (repeated teach-back with anxiety-appropriate framing), and safe bounded closure (clear residual risks and trigger conditions). All dimensions at least good, closure is valid.
